metrics.name: confluence_new_peu
metrics.definition: Confluence New PEU is a Product User's first-ever Paid Enablement for Confluence.
metrics.grain: Product User in a Tenant and Confluence product
metrics.time_rule: Attribute to the first-ever Confluence Paid Enablement; later restorations do not qualify again.

metrics.name: jira_new_peu
metrics.definition: Jira New PEU is a Product User's first-ever Paid Enablement for Jira.
metrics.grain: Product User in a Tenant and Jira product
metrics.time_rule: Attribute to the first-ever Jira Paid Enablement; later restorations do not qualify again.

metrics.name: confluence_new_mau
metrics.definition: Confluence New MAU is a New PEU with at least one Confluence Visit in the same calendar month as first paid enablement.
metrics.grain: Product User in a Tenant and Confluence product
metrics.time_rule: Attribute to first paid enablement only when a same-product Visit occurs in that calendar month.

metrics.name: jira_new_mau
metrics.definition: Jira New MAU is a New PEU with at least one Jira Visit in the same calendar month as first paid enablement.
metrics.grain: Product User in a Tenant and Jira product
metrics.time_rule: Attribute to first paid enablement only when a same-product Visit occurs in that calendar month.
